title: My latest AI-powered game built with 100% Gemini 2.5 Pro – looking for feedback!
author: Resident-Aspect4084
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1p5nt52/video/46rs61jts83g1/player

I just finished my latest AI-coding project, and I’d love to get your thoughts. This game was built 100% using Gemini 2.5 Pro, along with graphics generated by Nano Banana. Most of the development happened through Gemini 2.5 Pro in AI Studio by Google, which made prototyping super fast.

Now I’m experimenting with **Gemini CLI 3.0**, but that’s for another project — this one is all about the 2.5 Pro workflow.

If you have a few minutes, I’d love for you to:

* Try it out [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hill-dash-race/id6754823622](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hill-dash-race/id6754823622)
* Share what you think about the gameplay, mechanics, or overall feel
* Any tips or suggestions for improving AI-assisted development

I’m super curious to hear what other AI game developers think about using **fully AI-generated assets and code** in a complete project.

Thanks in advance for your feedback! 🙏

comments.author: TraditionalCry640
comments.body: Just played for a few minutes. It’s amusing but I’m not a fan of the physics. The forward and backward lean arrows are way too fast imo. Like I’m trying to just tip back a little bit on a jump and I flip upside down 😂 might play more later and give more feed back. It’s definitely a solid start tho. Also the terrain is way too easy. I’m basically holding gas and just going and I’m mostly good. Only gotta hit the back arrow a little bit sometimes. I haven’t unlocked the other terrain tho

replies.author: TraditionalCry640
replies.body: Just beat all of the second map only holding the gas. Didn’t hit the flip buttons all. Also I like the background on the second map but it makes it hard to see the ground sometimes imo
